name: Karasumori Amika
source:
[spoiler] She is Tsubaki's handler and general caretaker.  She is also 
 something of a sadist.  She knows her nature is twisted and enjoys that nature.  She frequently is violent (both sexually and physically) toward Tsubaki, who accepts this from her, though she does complain.  To Masataka, she is just an older-sister type relative.[/spoiler]
